components_select_zn: A minified helper function in the Filament select component's bundled JS.
components_slider_e: A minified helper function in the Filament slider component's bundled JS.
components_slider_g: A minified helper function in the Filament slider component's bundled JS.
components_slider_it: A minified helper function in the Filament slider component's bundled JS.
components_slider_we: A minified helper function in the Filament slider component's bundled JS.
components_tags_input: tags-input.js, the bundled JavaScript for the Filament forms tags-input component that lets users add and remove free-text tags.
components_territorylist: TerritoryList, a Livewire component in the real-estate-core-livewire module that lists sales/lettings territories.
components_validation_errors_blade: validation-errors.blade.php, a Blade component that renders form validation error messages beneath a field or form.
components_viewinglist_viewinglist_runfo: The runForCurrentTeam() method on ViewingList, a Livewire component in real-estate-viewings-livewire, that scopes viewing actions like cancel/confirm/no-show to the currently active team.
components_zooplasynclist: ZooplaSyncList, a Livewire component in the real-estate-zoopla-livewire module that lists Zoopla portal sync records.
concept_archive_instead_of_delete: A documented convention in the Rightmove Sync API spec that records are archived rather than hard-deleted, preserving history alongside immutable property history entries.
concept_ci_three_workflows: A CONFORMANCE.md decision (§3.9) that each package's CI runs as three separate reusable workflows rather than three jobs within one workflow.
concept_domain_docs_single_context: The domain.md convention that domain documentation for the host and all modules/themes lives in a single root CONTEXT.md and one docs/adr/ directory rather than being scattered per package.
concept_error_schema: A shared OpenAPI schema, defined in the real estate valuations API spec, used to represent error responses consistently across the real-estate API specs.
concept_foundation_module_matrix: The Foundation capability-to-package matrix in FOUNDATION_MODULE_MATRIX.md that maps foundation capabilities to the packages implementing them.
concept_host_boundary: The FOUNDATION_MODULE_MATRIX.md rule that the /app Filament panel is composition-only, with no domain logic living directly in the host.
concept_host_ci_gates: The host's own CI checks defined in .github/workflows/tests.yml, distinct from each package's own reusable CI workflows.
concept_laravel_boost_guidelines: The Laravel Boost guidance referenced from AGENTS.md that instructs Claude Code and similar agents on Laravel-specific conventions for this repository.
concept_liberu_real_estate: The Liberu Real Estate host application, a composition host built on the Liberu module/theme system, described in the project README.
concept_message_model: The Message model documented in MESSAGING.md, backing the private messaging system's messages table and MessageController.
concept_module_capabilities: The module.json manifest mechanism for declaring a module's provided and required capabilities, documented in MODULE_DEVELOPMENT.md.
concept_module_plugins_composer: App\Filament\ModulePlugins, the host class documented in MODULE_DEVELOPMENT.md that composes Filament panel plugins from each enabled module's manifest declarations.
concept_module_release_workflow: The documented workflow in MODULE_DEVELOPMENT.md for releasing a module change, from validation through fleet-wide publishing.
concept_module_search: The modules/search package documented in SEARCH_FUNCTIONALITY.md, providing the SearchService and search indexing capability.
concept_module_system: The module system described in CLAUDE.md whereby ModuleManagerServiceProvider discovers and boots liberu-module Composer packages based on their manifests.
concept_module_validate_command: The module:validate Artisan command documented in MODULE_DEVELOPMENT.md that checks module manifests and capability declarations for correctness.
concept_modules_is_composer_output: The documented fact, recorded in a conformance handoff, that the modules/ directory is Composer install output for tracked packages rather than hand-edited source.
concept_multi_language_support: The multi-language support feature documented in MULTI_LANGUAGE.md, covering locale resolution via SetLocale middleware and machine translation.
concept_new_message_notification: NewMessageNotification, a queued Laravel notification documented in NOTIFICATIONS.md that alerts users to new private messages.
concept_openapi_31_versioned_contract: The convention, documented across the real-estate API OpenAPI specs, that each real-estate API is published as a versioned OpenAPI 3.1.0 contract.
concept_package_exile: The CONFORMANCE.md decision (§3.4) that six out-of-scope packages, including search-demo, were removed from the fleet's scope.
concept_package_naming: The CONFORMANCE.md naming convention (§3.3) that a '-core' suffix marks a package as provider-neutral domain logic.
concept_packagist_naming: The CLAUDE.md convention that Packagist package names drop the 'module-' prefix used in the corresponding GitHub repository names.
concept_pagination_meta_schema: A shared OpenAPI schema, defined in the real estate valuations API spec, used to represent pagination metadata consistently across the real-estate API specs.
concept_publish_whole_fleet: The documented rule, recorded in a conformance handoff, that publishing mirrors every package in the fleet rather than only the ones that changed.
concept_rule_relocation: The CONFORMANCE.md change that reduced the host's architecture rules from twelve to eight by moving package-self-checkable rules into package-testbench.
concept_sanctum_bearer_security: The Sanctum bearer-token security scheme defined in the real estate valuations API's OpenAPI spec for authenticating API requests.
concept_sanctum_bearer_security_scheme: The Sanctum bearer-token security scheme defined in the real estate parties API's OpenAPI spec, shared across several real-estate API specs.
concept_scout_elasticsearch_future: A documented future search migration path in SEARCH_FUNCTIONALITY.md describing a potential move to a dedicated full-text search engine.
concept_search_api_endpoints: The search API endpoints documented in SEARCH_FUNCTIONALITY.md, served by SearchController and subject to search rate limiting.
